eyebrow: Over a collection you already have
code:
$servers = "SQL-PROD-01", "SQL-PROD-02", "SQL-PROD-03"

foreach ($server in $servers) {
    Write-Host "Checking $server..."
}
# Checking SQL-PROD-01...
# Checking SQL-PROD-02...
# Checking SQL-PROD-03...
caption: foreach: a language keyword over a variable — ForEach-Object does the same job mid-pipeline.

code:
$attempts = 0
$connected = $false

while (-not $connected -and $attempts -lt 5) {
    $attempts++
    Write-Host "Connection attempt $attempts..."
}
# Connection attempt 1...
# Connection attempt 2...
# Connection attempt 3...
caption: while doesn't know the iteration count in advance — right for retries and polling.
Start, condition, increment — right when the loop is genuinely about counting.
